'''Suzoku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|Private]] of the [[First Battalion]] in the [[Fifth Infantry]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. In [[3643 BBY]] Suzoku and his unit were stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] where they were sent to retrieve the plans for a neutron detonator from the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]]-infested ruins of [[Bugtown]]. Unfortunately, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Piloc]]'s incompetence led to Suzoku and half of the battalion being killed by the Colicoids. Before his death, Suzoku recorded one final holomessage, implicating Piloc in his death.<ref name="TOR" />
